note: THE CONTROL that makes the other seven attributable: kg's existing string comparison already answers exactly what Emacs answers, (nil t nil t), so what `compare-strings' adds is not comparison but the INDEX, the BOUNDS and the FLAG -- the three things the rows beside this one measure. It carries `expect: agree' inside a divergent row for the native-type-of reason: a feature is divergent, a case says which side of the line it is on.
